flood_risk.notes: South-east site edge intersects the mapped Flood Zone 2 boundary. Finished floor levels at ground and basement need a flood risk assessment.

transport.servicing_route_conflict: Proposed servicing route along High Street overlaps with the morning pedestrian peak window

utilities.notes: Existing substation at the north-east corner of the site constrains basement extent in that corner.

protected_views.notes: Site sits outside designated strategic view corridors, but is within the wider townscape sensitivity area referenced by Policy D9.
